description: Per-entrypoint Soroban CPU-instruction and memory ceilings, measured with the soroban-sdk testutils budget by the `budget_*` tests in backstop/bounty/grants/treasury. Ceilings = measured x (1 + headroom_pct/100), rounded up. Check: `cargo xtask budget-check`; regenerate: `cargo xtask budget-check --update`. Measured natively on the CI toolchain: host-function costs (storage, auth, token calls, events) are counted, guest wasm instructions are not.

initialize.rationale: one-time write of config + state structs

deposit.rationale: token transfer + share arithmetic + two persistent writes

withdraw.rationale: token transfer + share arithmetic + two persistent writes

cover_shortfall.rationale: authorization check + token transfer + state update

receive_premium.rationale: bps arithmetic + state update, no token transfer

approve_advisory.rationale: approver-set membership scan + approval list scan + threshold-crossing reservation + event

pay_advisory.rationale: window check + reservation release + token transfer + settlement event

resolve_dispute.rationale: governance auth + re-score + reservation release + token transfer + settlement event

approve_advisory_worst_case.rationale: MAX_APPROVERS (20) set, 20-of-20 threshold: final approval scans the full approver set and approval list, then reserves escrow

set_approvers.rationale: governance auth + bounded O(M^2) duplicate check (M <= 20) + config write

submit_application.rationale: counter increment + persistent application write + event

approve_application.rationale: milestone sum validation + two persistent writes (app + grant) + event

confirm_milestone.rationale: in-order scan (bounded by milestone count) + grant write

claim.rationale: token transfer + milestone flag scan + grant write

approve_application_worst_case.rationale: 24-milestone grant: validates and writes the full milestone list

claim_worst_case.rationale: claims 24 confirmed milestones: full flag scan + token transfer

confirm_milestone_worst_case.rationale: confirms the 24th milestone: in-order scan over all earlier milestones
